issues.message: 442 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.

notes.detail: Good interior (beds, kitchen, study) but the outside is bare for a noble house: no shutters, flower boxes or lanterns until L2.
notes.artefacts: Garden path of cobblestone slabs steps diagonally and only touches at corners, so it reads as broken pieces; a two-stair bench stands alone in the grass.
notes.purpose: Reads as a well-built timber house; nothing yet says noble (that comes in L2).

visual.summary: The shell: a stone and half-timbered manor with spruce gable roof, front cross gable, back dormer and brick chimney, furnished hall, kitchen and bedrooms.
problems: Garden path (cobblestone_slab y0: (8..10,1), (11,2..4), (10,5), (12,5), (13,6..8), (12,9)) joins only at corners: make it a continuous 1-wide path with straight runs and full corners.
Bench at (15,0,6)-(15,0,7) is two bare spruce stairs with no arms: add trapdoor arms (as L2 does) or move it beside the path.
Reach: 201 of 293 places reached; unreached are roof slopes, eaves and two chimney ledges: fine.
